clips.title: The story
paras: In Booty Bay, the goblin Crank Fizzlebub has set his sights on the potent concoction brewed by the exiled troll Zanzil. Zanzil uses this botanical blend to dominate the minds and empower the bodies of his followers among the nearby jungle ruins. Believing such a substance holds immense value for anyone seeking to control others, Fizzlebub wants samples retrieved for his own uses.

Northeast of Booty Bay, the outcast troll known as Zanzil has made a haven in the ruins of Jubuwal and Aboraz. Cast out by his former tribal leaders because they feared his mastery over the minds of others, Zanzil commands a band of followers entirely through concoctions derived from jungle vegetation. These mixtures deaden their will while enhancing their physical might, turning them into docile yet sturdy thralls.

Crank Fizzlebub sees clear opportunity in the exile's craft. Anyone desiring dominance over others would pay handsomely for such an elixir, prompting the goblin to seek a supply directly from the ruins. Delivering enough samples secures not only standard coin but a quiet bonus, provided the carrier keeps quiet about the transaction.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Zanzil the Outcast dwells with his followers in the Jubuwai and Aboraz Ruins, northeast of Booty Bay. He is exiled from his tribe. Why? Well...
Zanzil has methods of bending the minds of others, and his leaders fear him. He uses a mixture of jungle plants on his followers to suppress their will and strengthen their bodies.
His mixture would be worth much to those who wish to control others.
Bring me samples of his mixture, and I will find a use for them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the samples of Zanzil's Mixture??

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, very good! Here is your pay.
And here is a little something extra... For your discretion.
